summary: Validate Koru model responses before route success

delivery.outcome: Task-invalid Koru JSON is rejected before a model attempt is accepted, while existing policy controls fallback and plain-text/custom backend compatibility remains intact.

architecture.decision: Keep response acceptance with the Koru task. Default structured calls use public SubLLM complete with the declared JSON format and a bounded predicate; central routing owns accounting and model fallback. Existing grammar/schema validation remains read-only. Custom complete signatures and plain-text chat transport stay compatible.
interfaceChanges: Add the checked default-backend path without changing injected complete signatures.
architecture.rollback: Revert the bounded application patch through protected review; no state or data migration is required.

nonGoals: No standard upgrade, provider policy change, LLM judge, global model quarantine, command execution or universal semantic-correctness claim.

validation.evidence: Task gates reject unsupported actions and malformed types before central acceptance; canonical and legacy aliases submit JSON and their task predicates.
Invalid DSL, ambiguous JSON and string install flags fail safely without executing commands; valid grammar/schema fixtures are accepted.

commands: python -m pytest -q tests/test_koru_queue_argv.py tests/test_mcp_server.py tests/test_planfile_queue.py tests/test_queue_cli_helpers.py
validation.evidence: Required protected baseline plus independent exact-head validation; custom backends and plain-text rewriting retain their interfaces.
